verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Gitea has an official MCP server, documented at gitea.com/gitea/gitea-mcp, hosted on the vendor's own forge. That is a first-party server an agent can connect to, so the axis applies and is delivered, but the evidence is a single thin probe entry with no detail. Missing for 10: documentation of the exposed tools and resources, transport and auth setup for connecting an agent, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent connections.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: official MCP server documented at https://gitea.com/gitea/gitea-mcp
